name: In This Dream of Ours
source: In This Dream of Ours is a kinetic novel set in an alternate version of the dawn of the Edo Period (early 1600s, Japan). It stars Kouji, a commoner forced into becoming a warrior, whose injured body was taken from the aftermath of a decisive battle between East and West, and brought to the nearest village’s clinic. It’s there that he heals under the care of Hitomi, a girl whose father fought alongside Kouji, and her brother, Yasahiro, who trains in order to make his father proud on his return home. The longer Kouji stays with them, the more he realizes that his connection to them is stronger than just a chance meeting…
translation: 《In This Dream of Ours》是一部以架空的江戶時代初期（17世紀初，日本）為舞臺的線性小說。主角浩二是一個被迫成為戰士的平民，東西兩軍決戰後，受了傷的他被人從戰場送到最近的村莊診所。在那裡，他在瞳——一個父親曾與浩二並肩作戰的女孩——以及她的弟弟康廣的照料下康復。康廣為了在父親回來時讓他驕傲而刻苦訓練。浩二和他們在一起的時間越長，就越意識到他們之間的聯絡不僅僅是偶然的相遇……
